index.disclaimer: This index summarizes comparative database evidence. It is not a probability of folding, expression, pairing, binding, stability, manufacturability, safety, efficacy, or experimental success.
limitations: The index rests on 95% of its weight set. The geometric mean divides by the weight that contributed, so an incomplete index is numerically indistinguishable from a complete one -- this coverage figure is the only thing that distinguishes them. Absent slots: ['Constant/Fc region'].
Variable-domain scope: no constant-region evidence contributed, so this index says nothing about the constant region or the construct as a whole. The name carries the qualifier for that reason.

missing_evidence.pairing_precedent.vh_vl_germline_pair_pr: germline V-gene assignment now exists (para_scope.germline, OGRDB human reference) and returns a gene call for every variable domain tested, so the original blocker -- that nothing populated EvidenceClass.GERMLINE -- is resolved. What remains is the reference table this dimension actually needs: which VH germline gene is observed paired with which VL germline gene, and how often, across the 12,032 observed pairs. Building it means germline-assigning every unique paired variable domain, which is a separate offline job (one alignment per reference allele per component). Until that table exists this dimension reports nothing rather than guessing from the per-chain gene calls, which would describe gene co-occurrence in a candidate rather than precedent in a database
missing_evidence.pairing_precedent.combined_cdr_pattern_s: CDRs are short components and require a length-matched empirical null model before any similarity over them is meaningful (SPEC S21). That null is Gate 9 work. Exact CDR identity within a matched pair needs no chance correction and is reported per match instead

unavailable_layer4_fields.study_count: Neither SAbDab2 nor Thera-SAbDab records a study identifier distinct from the structure or therapeutic entry, so independent studies cannot be counted without conflating them with records.
unavailable_layer4_fields.subject_count: Subject-level provenance exists only in repertoire sources (OAS). promb's bundled reference is pre-aggregated at a 10%-of-subjects threshold and exposes no per-subject counts.
unavailable_layer4_fields.bootstrap_interval: Requires resampling a reference distribution per query. The calibration artifact stores full observations so this is computable, but it is not computed here and an interval has not been validated.

strength.grade_rationale: Identity 1.000 repeated across 2 parent antibodies, but no structure-linked experimental context.
strength.disclaimer: An evidence grade describes the strength and provenance of the database evidence found, not the candidate. Grade A means direct, curated, same-component experimental evidence exists -- it is not a statement that the candidate will fold, express, pair, bind, be stable, be safe, be effective, or succeed.
limitations: Grade thresholds are provisional (version 1.1.0-provisional). SPEC §19 requires them to be benchmarked; no external ground truth of evidence quality exists to benchmark against, so what has been verified is that the bands separate real corpus cases rather than collapsing onto one grade.
